instruction: Adjust the image to make it less bright.

metadata.explanation: Task requires decreasing the brightness of the image. Evaluator uses custom getter to calculate average brightness and metric to verify it decreased from the original value. Verified original image brightness: 113.76 (calculated from grayscale conversion). Similar complexity to original palette conversion task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly calculates brightness using grayscale conversion and ImageStat.mean[0] - appropriate method for measuring image brightness
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('original_brightness') without incorrectly looking for expected.get('rules')
Comparison logic is correct - checks if result_brightness < original_brightness - tolerance, properly verifying brightness decreased
Postconfig appropriately exports the modified image (Shift+Ctrl+E) to make the changes accessible for verification
Expected value (113.76) is semantically correct - stated to be calculated from the original image
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies the single requirement (brightness decreased) from the instruction
Data flow is correct - getter returns {'brightness': float}, metric compares against original_brightness
Edge cases handled - metric checks for None values in both result and expected parameters
Tolerance mechanism (default 5.0) provides robustness against minor variations
